# Marvis AI

> Marvis is a free, open-source, privacy-first desktop AI copilot for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs locally as a floating bar above your workspace, provides screen-aware assistance with explicit permission, transcribes meetings locally, and connects to AI providers with zero cloud storage.

## Core Features
- **Screen-Aware Context**: Press ⌘⏎ (Ctrl+Enter on Windows/Linux) to send your active screen frame along with your prompt ("explain this", "what changed", "debug this"). Screen frames are stored solely in an in-memory 60-second rolling ring (≤120 frames, ≤64 MB) and never touch the disk.
- **Real-Time Meeting Transcription**: Transcribes mic and system audio into speaker-labeled transcripts with rolling TLDR summaries every 5 turns. Supports on-device whisper.cpp and sherpa models for 100% offline transcription, plus optional hosted Deepgram streaming.
- **BYOK & Local LLMs**: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and OpenRouter, or run completely local and offline using Ollama or OpenAI-compatible local endpoints.
- **Local-First Privacy Architecture**: No user accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync, and no Marvis servers. All data stays in `~/.marvis/` on your device.

## System Architecture & Security
- **Directory**: `~/.marvis/` (POSIX permissions 0700)
- **API Keys**: `~/.marvis/keys.json` (permissions 0600, masked as `…last4` in UI)
- **Configuration**: `~/.marvis/config.toml` (permissions 0644, providers, hotkeys, window geometry)
- **Database**: `~/.marvis/marvis.db` (permissions 0600, SQLite database for sessions and transcripts)
- **Speech Models**: `~/.marvis/models/` (on-device whisper.cpp and sherpa ASR models)
- **Audio Workspace**: `~/.marvis/tmp/` (scratch audio processing)
- **Screen Buffer**: In-memory ring buffer (maximum 60 seconds / 64 MB RAM, zero disk writes)

## Supported Platforms
- **macOS**: Apple Silicon & Intel (macOS 13+) via ScreenCaptureKit
- **Windows**: Windows 10/11 x86_64 via Windows Graphics Capture (WGC) and WASAPI audio
- **Linux**: x86_64 distributions via XDG desktop portal and PipeWire

## Default Keyboard Shortcuts
- Global: Show / hide input: `⌘ ⌥ Space` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Alt+Space` (Windows/Linux)
- Global: Toggle screen capture: `⌘ ⌥ R` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Alt+R` (Windows/Linux)
- Global: Start meeting transcription (Listen): `⌘ ⌥ T` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Alt+T` (Windows/Linux)
- Global: Session history: `⌘ ⌥ H` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Alt+H` (Windows/Linux)
- Global: Lock bar position: `⌘ ⇧ L` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Shift+L` (Windows/Linux)
- In the Bar: Send with screen frame: `⌘ ⏎` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Enter` (Windows/Linux)
- In the Bar: Send prompt: `Enter`
- In the Bar: New line: `Shift+Enter`
- In the Bar: Open settings: `⌘ ,` (macOS) / `Ctrl+,` (Windows/Linux)
